title: Emrys and the Songbook
author: Gideon Nystrom
blurb: Emrys Vasquez, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
